description: This file defines the class TappedUserFallbackUserDictionary, which extends FallbackUserDictionary and manages a WordReadListener for user tap events within a preferences provider context.

classes.name: TappedUserFallbackUserDictionary
classes.description: A subclass of FallbackUserDictionary that uses a WordReadListener to handle word read events triggered by user taps.

methods.name: TappedUserFallbackUserDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dictionary with context, locale, and a WordReadListener.

methods.name: createWordReadListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the WordReadListener associated with this instance.
